name: Downhill Day
summary: Sample file for testing. The real one is written by Claude every morning.

drills.name: Spin & Stop
drills.summary: Spin dribble into a hard jump-stop, then explode back out.
steps: Dribble at half-court speed toward the elbow.
Land a two-foot jump-stop, ball tight to your chest.
Rip it through and go the other way.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-Up Ladder
drills.summary: One-dribble pull-ups from both elbows, stepping back each make.
steps: Start at the free-throw line, one dribble to the right elbow and pull up.
Make it, take one step back.
Switch to the left elbow halfway through.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Finishes
drills.summary: Finish with the hand away from the help defender.
steps: Put a cone on the block as the help defender.
Drive from the wing toward the cone.
Finish high off the glass with the hand farthest from the cone.

drills.name: Sideline Sprints
drills.summary: Sideline to sideline sprints with a defensive slide back.
steps: Start on one sideline in your stance.
Sprint to the far sideline and touch it.
Defensive slide back halfway, then sprint to finish.
